# New Lines

7 options in this group.

| Key | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [csharp_new_line_before_open_brace](csharp_new_line_before_open_brace.md) | `all` | Which constructs put their opening brace on a new line. |
| [csharp_new_line_before_else](csharp_new_line_before_else.md) | `true` | Put else on its own line rather than joining it to the preceding brace. |
| [csharp_new_line_before_catch](csharp_new_line_before_catch.md) | `true` | Put catch on its own line. |
| [csharp_new_line_before_finally](csharp_new_line_before_finally.md) | `true` | Put finally on its own line. |
| [csharp_new_line_before_members_in_object_initializers](csharp_new_line_before_members_in_object_initializers.md) | `false` | Put each member of an object initializer on its own line. |
| [csharp_new_line_before_members_in_anonymous_types](csharp_new_line_before_members_in_anonymous_types.md) | `false` | Put each member of an anonymous type on its own line. |
| [csharp_new_line_between_query_expression_clauses](csharp_new_line_between_query_expression_clauses.md) | `false` | Put each clause of a query expression on its own line. |
